**Anticoagulation treatment** (*antikoagulationsbehandling*) is a life-saving pharmacological intervention primarily indicated for patients with [[atrieflimren|atrieflimren]] (atrial fibrillation) to prevent severe complications such as [[iskaemisk-apopleksi|Iskæmisk apopleksi]] (ischemic stroke) [^src4] [^src8]. The clinical indication for initiating this treatment is based on the [[cha2ds2-vasc|CHA2DS2-VASc]] risk score, with a score of ≥2 serving as the definitive cutoff for both sexes, as no points are awarded for female sex in this specific calculation context [^src1] [^src2] [^src10]. The treatment encompasses various drug classes, including Vitamin K antagonists ([[b01aa|B01AA]], e.g., [[marevan|marevan]]) and Direct Oral Anticoagulants ([[doac|DOAC]]), such as dabigatran ([[b01ae07|B01AE07]]), rivaroxaban ([[b01af01|B01AF01]]), apixaban ([[b01af02|B01AF02]]), and edoxaban ([[b01af03|B01AF03]]) [^src8] [^src11] [^src13].

In the Danish healthcare quality monitoring system, the timely initiation of anticoagulation is a critical performance metric. [[indikator-1|Indikator 1]] specifically measures the proportion of newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients who begin treatment within 30 days of their diagnosis [^src1] [^src4] [^src11]. The national quality standard for this metric is set at [[standard-90-percent|Standard: ≥90 %]] [^src3] [^src4]. Long-term adherence and treatment coverage are further tracked by [[indikator-4a|Indikator 4a]] and its sub-indicators ([[indikator-4a1|Indikator 4a1]], [[indikator-4a2|Indikator 4a2]], and [[indikator-4a3|Indikator 4a3]]), which evaluate the proportion of indicated patients still receiving treatment 1, 2, and 5 years post-diagnosis, respectively [^src3] [^src6] [^src7]. Data for these indicators are supported by national registries, including the [[laegemiddelstatistikregisteret|Lægemiddelstatistikregisteret]] [^src4].

Recent performance data demonstrates that Denmark has successfully met the ≥90% standard for Indicator 1 on a national level, with 92% of eligible newly diagnosed patients starting oral anticoagulation within the 30-day window [^src1] [^src4]. Regional results are highly homogeneous, though [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] achieved marginally higher fulfillment rates of approximately 93% [^src4]. At the health cluster level, most clusters meet the standard, but historical data from 2018–2019 highlights variations, such as an 80.0% coverage in [[sundhedsklynge-bornholm|Sundhedsklynge Bornholm]] compared to 94.1% in [[klynge-nord|Klynge NORD]] [^src4] [^src7]. Furthermore, supplementary analyses reveal that 55.6% of patients actually started treatment within four months prior to their formal diagnosis, while 65.5% of atrial fibrillation patients admitted with an ischemic stroke had redeemed an oral anticoagulation prescription within 100 days before admission [^src8]. 

The monitoring of these metrics follows a strict chronological framework. For instance, the data collection period for Indicator 1 covering the 2022–2023 annual report began on July 1, 2022, and the subsequent annual period runs from July 1, 2023, to June 30, 2024 [^src1] [^src4].

- Andelen af atrieflimren-patienter indlagt med iskæmisk apopleksi/apopleksi af ukendt type, som havde indløst recept på oral antikoagulationsbehandling inden for 100 dage før indlæggelsen, var 65,5 % på nationalt plan [^src1] (atrieflimren-i-danmark, iskaemisk-apopleksi, antikoagulationsbehandling)
  Type: pharmacovigilance
  Page: 71
  Source: wikis/rkkp-afdk/raw/AFDK_2024.pdf, pages 71-75
- Der er ved beregningen af CHA2DS2-VASc score ikke givet point for kvindekøn, og ≥2 er derfor anvendt som skæringpunkt for indikation for antikoagulationsbehandling hos begge køn. [^src1] (cha2ds2-vasc, antikoagulationsbehandling)
  Type: clinical-policy
  Page: 92
  Source: wikis/rkkp-afdk/raw/AFDK_2024.pdf, pages 91-95
- Indikator 1 måler andelen af nydiagnosticerede patienter med atrieflimren, der har ventetid på max. 30 dage fra diagnosticering til opstart i antikoagulations-behandling (hvor antikoagulations-behandling er indiceret) [^src1] (atrieflimren, antikoagulationsbehandling)
  Type: quality-indicator
  Page: 104
  Source: wikis/rkkp-afdk/raw/AFDK_2024.pdf, pages 101-105
- For indikator 1 er tælleren patienter i nævneren som har ventetid til opstart i oral AK-behandling inden for tidsrammen 120 dage før til 30 dage efter 1. diagnosedato (udskrivelsesdato ved indlagte forløb) [^src1] (antikoagulationsbehandling)
  Type: definition
  Page: 104
  Source: wikis/rkkp-afdk/raw/AFDK_2024.pdf, pages 101-105

## Timeline
- 2022-07-01: Start af dataindsamlingsperiode for Indikator 1 (1. juli 2022) (atrieflimren, antikoagulationsbehandling)
- 2023-07-01: Start af aktuel årspériode for Indikator 1 (01.07.2023 - 30.06.2024) (atrieflimren, antikoagulationsbehandling)
- 2024-06-30: Slut på aktuel årspériode for Indikator 1 (01.07.2023 - 30.06.2024) (atrieflimren, antikoagulationsbehandling)
